dataList.content:
More and more Bloodfiends are starting to suffer.
感到痛苦的血魔正在逐渐增多。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland

dataList.content:
Sancho.
桑丘。

How rude of you to attempt to lecture our Father?
你诚惶诚恐地向父亲提出忠告的样子可真丢人。

I am only notifying him of what I am seeing out there.
我只是在报告事实。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
Ah, Sancho. I have been discussing with Dulcinea about the pathing of the Parade.
啊，桑丘。我正在和杜尔西内娅一起讨论游行路线。

It seems that your Area is the most popular out of them all, Dulcinea.
看起来你的区域最有人气啊，杜尔西内娅。

Of course. It is in nature of all things to be helplessly drawn to beauty.
那是当然。所有生物都具备着被美所吸引的天性。

I don't think I've ever seen the two of you exchange more than three sentences with one another, now that I think about it.
这么看来我好像从没见过你们两个聊上三句以上的时候。

You're both Second Kindreds of mine, aren't you? Sisters. Would you like to be the 'big sis', Sancho?
你们都是一样的二代眷属啊。是姐妹。桑丘，你要当姐姐吗？

Absolutely not. I detest this idea.
我打心底里不愿意。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
Then perhaps I would suggest a 'lil sis'—
那么就当妹……

I will now take my leave, O Father.
我先行告退了，父亲啊。

... Also.
……以及。

Please, consider our suggestion regarding that Relic.
关于我们提起过的那个遗物的事情，也请您考虑一番。

Yes, I will.
好吧。我会的。

You come at the most appropriate hour, Sancho. Behold, for I have found us a Relic yesterday.
桑丘，你来得正好。看看这个。昨天我又入手了个遗物。
dataList.place:
A Certain Castle, Past
过去，某座城堡

dataList.content:
You're still searching for them...?
您还在继续收集这些物品么……
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
I thought you had given up on the idea. The Knight of the White Moon identified the last one, which you had gone through considerable lengths to obtain, mind, was but a forgery.
我还以为您已经放弃了。上次您好不容易拿到手的物品经过白月骑士临行前的鉴定不也是赝品来着。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
Yet the merchant claimed that this one was of genuine quality.
但这次商人说是真货。

Behold the hatch-pattern here; it is identical to the depiction of the helm worn by the founding Fixer of the Hana Association.
尤其是这里的纹样，简直就和初代하나协会的收尾人所佩戴的头盔一模一样不是么？

Compare it next to this illustration. Do you see the resemblance?
再和这里的插画比较一下。一模一样？对吧？

They duped you. Again.
您又上当了，一如既往。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
... Dammit all, I had a feeling. Damn that peddler to hell.
……我就知道会这样，那个该死的商人。

Why are you so desperately seeking these trinkets?
您为什么总是试图收集那些东西呢？
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
You are powerful enough without the crutches these Relics provide.
就算不借助这些所谓遗物的力量，您也无可匹敌。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
It is not for their strength that I seek them. What I truly seek is the body odor of the Fixers who had once worn them, their histories, the tales they have to tell...
我那么做并不是为了遗物蕴含的力量。我真正寻求的是那些遗物中所蕴含的收尾人们的气息、历史、故事……

... You look like you're looking at a nutcase.
……你简直就是一副见着疯子的表情啊。

What a relief. At least your eyesight is in fine health.
所幸您的视力姑且正常。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
This won't do. I would much earlier have those Relics in my hands by going out there myself.
没办法了。看来还是我亲自奔波寻找遗物会更快一些。

That's all well and good, but did you hear what I had to report earlier? That...
但是话说回来您有在听我说过的话吗。刚刚我报告过……
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
... That Bloodfiends are suffering?
你是指血魔们正在感到痛苦的事情吗？

I did not expect this path we walk to be an easy, paved road.
我没有期望过从一开始就能顺风顺水。

Yet we will overcome this together, as long as we manage to acclimatize to this.
但只要能适应下去，应该就可以顺利克服了吧。

You seem to be doing quite well yourself, for one.
你不也好好挺住了嘛。

Oh, and Sancho... I have conceived an idea most ingenious.
而且桑丘，我想到了个好主意。

What is it this time...?
这次又是什么……
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
It is truly ingenious this time, so I shall allow you to take a deep breath before I say anything. Are you ready?
真的是非常了不起的点子，你可要做好深呼吸再听。准备好了吗？

Yep...
是的……
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
Won't you set off on an adventure by my side?
要不要和我一起去冒险？

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
How did the consultations go?
咨询的氛围如何？

All are at peace. Tranquil, as they always are.
一如既往，所有人都处于一片祥和之中。

Speaking of which, did you take your daily dose of hemobar today?
说来您今天食用血棒了吗？

I did.
嗯，吃过了。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
Very good.
很好。

Ah, I heard through the grapevine that you were preparing to embark on an 'adventure' with Father.
啊，我听说您正在与父亲一起进行冒险的准备。

The sheer idea of it...
真是听起来就……

... I can hardly wait.
让人……期待万分。

You... No, it's nothing. You may leave me, now.
你……没什么。退下吧。
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
I wasn't so close to him that I could simply call over to him and ask him what he really meant by that pause.
我与神父的关系并没有亲密到能将像是在隐瞒某事的他再度唤回。

So I let him go.
我便这么让他离开了。

We could never get used to it.
我们终究还是无法适应。
dataList.place:
Fathoms of Ego - Maze
自我心道 - 迷宫

dataList.content:
The lack of blood... It's incomparable to having one's favorite food taken away from them.
因为我们不仅仅是失去了可口的美食，

It deprived us of everything that made us happy.
凡是与我们的幸福有所关联的一切，都被夺去了。

Drenched in misery, naively hanging onto the belief that everything was going to be okay. Slowly, we...
坚信着一切都会好起来的所有人，都被不幸侵蚀……

We grew deprived.
慢慢地被侵蚀着。

So that's...
所以后来……

... when the two of you left La Manchaland to go on an adventure.
两人离开拉·曼却领去冒险了啊。
